description.value:
You are one of millions grown from the same genetic template — identical in body, engineered from birth to be the perfect soldier, and trained alongside countless brothers who share your face. You served in the ranks of a galaxy-spanning military, and that service shaped you as surely as your genes did.

No two clones turn out quite the same despite the shared coding, and you've built a personality, a sense of humor, and a loyalty to your squad that are entirely your own.

toolProficiencies: Your choice of demolitions kit, security kit, or slicer's kit
system.equipment: A badge or emblem of your rank, a set of common clothes, and a pouch containing 100 credits.
